name: B10-0091/2026 (Renew) – Case of Joseph Figueira Martin in the Central African Republic
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Joseph Figueira Martin in the Central African Republic
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of Joseph Figueira Martin, a Belgian-Portuguese humanitarian worker held in the Central African Republic. He was kidnapped in May 2024, tortured, held without trial for over a year, and in November 2025 sentenced to 10 years of forced labour. The Parliament demands his immediate release, medical evacuation and consular help. It also asks the European Union to prepare sanctions and to tie future cooperation and funding to his release. This is a request, not a change in law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament asks the European Union to prepare sanctions and link aid to his release.
- **Who it affects:** Joseph Figueira Martin, the Central African Republic authorities, and European Union funding and cooperation with that country.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to the European Union institutions and the Central African Republic. The Parliament also wants a visit to monitor his case.
